about_the_game:
This edition combines The Chronicles of Lancelot 1 and The Chronicles of Lancelot 2 into one unforgettable, deliciously NSFW fantasy adventure! xD

✨ Play both Lancelot 1 & 2 in one complete game.✨

Welcome to The Chronicles of Lancelot: COMBO EDITION – the definitive gay RPG bundle where passion meets plot, magic meets muscles, and drama meets dungeon crawling! 

Embark on a chaotic, heart-throbbing journey as Sir Lancelot — a dashing, occasionally dumb, always hot knight with a heart full of dreams (and maybe a few shirtless friends). In this outrageous blend of romance, betrayal, magic, and scandalous fun, you'll explore kingdoms, flirt with enemies, unlock secrets (and clothes), and maybe even save the world while getting lucky in the process. xD

🌈 FEATURES:

  • 🎮 Two full 3D gay RPGs in one bundle – over 30 hours of fabulous, fantasy gameplay.

  • 💪 Meet, romance, and... do things with 15+ stunning male companions across both games.

  • 🧙‍♂️ Use powerful magic, swing sexy swords, and survive hilariously inappropriate boss fights.

  • ❤️ Enjoy over 30+ intimate, story-driven NSFW scenes, each more legendary than the last.

  • 🐷 Ride dragons, escape dungeons, explore floating kingdoms, and flirt with shirtless elves.

  • 💃 Includes Gold Edition extras: Go-Go Boy Club, extra character & dungeon, and the sizzling Gawain route.

  • 📜 Follow the tangled, dramatic love story between Lancelot and Prince Arthur — a pairing hotter than Excalibur in a lava bath.🎭

Step into a lavishly illustrated reimagining of Arthurian legend — a world where desire is as potent as destiny.

Explore the realms of Camelot and beyond: from enchanted forests, ancient ruins, treacherous dungeons, and skybound kingdoms to the mythical treasure vaults of Avalon. Discover the floating empire of Pantheron and the hedonistic isle of Arcadion — a sanctuary where pleasure meets prophecy.

Lancelot’s father, Ban, is accused of poisoning King Uther and Merlin with a cursed artifact known as God’s Tear. Uther lies dead, Merlin in a coma, and Excalibur has vanished — right before Ban himself is slain.

Now, with the realm on the brink of collapse, Lancelot must uncover the truth behind his father's legacy, navigating a maze of conspiracies, forbidden love, and ancient magic.

Meanwhile, Mordred — the orphaned royal foster child with a vendetta against Uther’s bloodline — escapes captivity and sets his own dark plans into motion.

Though Prince Arthur secretly harbors love for Lancelot, circumstances spiral beyond control. Lancelot is imprisoned, and the man he loves signs his death sentence. What could have torn them apart?

A knight of unmatched skill and reckless charm, hiding his loyal heart behind sharp wit and wilder desires. Forever caught in the power struggles of Camelot, he must face his past — and his feelings for Arthur — to survive.

The young Prince of Camelot — brave, noble, and hopelessly torn. With Uther dead and Merlin silenced, Arthur stands alone, a ruler without a guide, caught between the man he loves and the kingdom he must protect.

A fledgling guardian from the airborne realm of Pantheron. Jaime brought God’s Tear to Earth in hopes of peace, only to find himself entangled in chaos. Well-meaning but impulsive, he complicates more than he resolves.

A stoic and fiercely loyal knight of the Round Table, secretly transgender. Asher shields Arthur from the shadowy threats within the court while guarding secrets of his own.

Hot-headed and proud, Kay grew up alongside Lancelot — once brothers-in-arms, now uneasy rivals. His father died after slaying Ban, leaving their bond haunted by blood and betrayal.

New Allies and Rivals:

  • Lady of the Lake:

    This mysterious figure appears in the form desired by those who seek her. She’s imprisoned deep beneath Avalon, and freeing her will be no small feat.

  • Mordred:

    Takumi:

    • A treasure hunter from the East, Takumi attempts to steal Avalon’s treasure map but gets caught and imprisoned in Camelot.

    • Thaloris: The charismatic merman steward of the Lady of the Lake provides crucial information about Avalon’s treasures.

    • Taliesin: Camelot’s eccentric scholar invents a flying ship to aid Lancelot on his journey to Pantheron. His poetic wit remains as sharp as ever.

    • Innika: A fallen angel bound to the Archangel Ramiel, Innika serves as a reminder of the high cost of redemption.

  • And that’s just the beginning—dozens more intriguing characters await to charm, challenge, and sometimes frustrate you!

👑 GENRES:

NSFW Gay RPG • Visual Novel • Fantasy Adventure • Turn-Based Combat • Romance • Pervert

🏳️‍🌈 A GAME MADE FOR GAYS, BY GAYS

If you ever wanted to save the world with your shirt off, get railed in a magical forest, or flirt your way through a dungeon, this game is for you. With humor, heart, and a whole lot of homoerotic chaos, Lancelot Combo is a fantasy adventure where every knight is Mr. Right (Now).

Buy the game now or prepare to be slain... with love. 💘

content_descriptors.notes: Regarding sexual content, players may encounter scenes that depict consensual sexual activity between adult male characters. Additionally, there may be instances where sexual assault or non-consensual sex is portrayed as part of the narrative. We handle such sensitive topics with care and respect, ensuring they are presented in a thoughtful manner that contributes meaningfully to the story arc.
